pests.name: Yellow Stem Borer
pests.damage_symptoms: Larva bores into central leaf sheath producing dead hearts in vegetative stage and white ears at panicle stage.
pests.biological_control: Release egg parasitoid Trichogramma japonicum @ 1,00,000/ha twice at 7 days interval.
pests.chemical_control: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3 ml/L or Cartap hydrochloride 50% SP @ 2 g/L.

pests.name: Brown Plant Hopper (BPH)
pests.damage_symptoms: Sucks sap causing circular yellowing patches that dry rapidly, known as hopper burn.
pests.favorable_conditions: Submerged water conditions, cloudy skies, high nitrogen fertilization.
pests.biological_control: Conserve mirid bugs (Cyrtorhinus lividipennis) and spiders.
pests.chemical_control: Pymetrozine 50% WDG @ 0.6 g/L or Dinotefuran 20% SG @ 0.4 g/L.

diseases.name: Rice Blast
diseases.damage_symptoms: Spindle-shaped spots on leaves with grey centers and brown margins; nodal and neck rotting.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Intermittent drizzles, cloudy weather, high relative humidity (>90%), cool nights (18-20°C).
diseases.biological_control: Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/kg seed.
diseases.chemical_control: Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g/L or Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5 ml/L.

diseases.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB)
diseases.damage_symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on leaf margins enlarging into wavy yellow-white stripes; bacterial ooze beads on leaves.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Strong winds, severe rainstorms, temperatures of 25-34°C with 70% RH.
diseases.biological_control: Spray fresh cow dung extract 20% or neem oil 3%.
diseases.chemical_control: Streptocycline 100 ppm + Copper oxychloride 50 WP @ 2.5 g/L.

pests.name: Wheat Aphids
pests.damage_symptoms: Nymphs and adults suck sap from tender shoots, leaves, and ears, secreting honeydew causing sooty mold.
pests.chemical_control: Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.2 g/L or Dimethoate 30% EC @ 1.5 ml/L.

diseases.name: Yellow Rust (Stripe Rust)
diseases.damage_symptoms: Yellowish uredinial pustules arranged in linear stripes along veins of leaf blades.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Cool temperatures (10-15°C) coupled with high humidity/dew.

pests.name: Pink Bollworm
pests.damage_symptoms: Larvae bore into flower buds causing rosette flowers; bore into bolls staining lint.
pests.favorable_conditions: Continuous warm, dry weather during boll formation.
pests.chemical_control: Profenofos 50% EC @ 2 ml/L or Emamectin benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4 g/L.

diseases.name: Cotton Leaf Curl Virus (CLCuV)
diseases.damage_symptoms: Upward/downward leaf curling, thickening of veins, and enations on the undersurface of leaves.
diseases.favorable_conditions: Abundant whitefly vector populations in high temperature and dry spells.
diseases.biological_control: Yellow sticky traps @ 25/ha for monitoring and trapping whitefly vectors.
diseases.chemical_control: Control vector with Diafenthiuron 50% WP @ 1.2 g/L.
